summary: Linear-interpolated lookup into a 256-entry single-precision trig table. Reads the double input at this[12] (byte offset 0x60), scales it by 4.0 and subtracts 0.5, then uses the integer-truncated result as a byte table index and the fractional part to interpolate between that entry and the next. Returns the interpolated double. No branches, no calls.

operations.description: Read the input double this[12] (byte offset 0x60) and scale it by 4.0 into v4.
v3 = v4 - 0.5, offsetting the scaled value before index truncation.
Read the lower table entry: v1 = flt_8AAE74[(unsigned __int8)(int)v3], index wrapped to a byte.
Compute the fractional interpolation weight (v4 - (double)(int)v3) between the two adjacent table entries.
Return the interpolated trig table value.
